cites: a deployment configuration whose label is the first sixteen hex characters of the SHA-256 of the secret it names. Every request then publishes a digest of the secret on the wire, and a rotation that keeps the secret cannot keep the label. The checker holds the secret and the configuration, so it can recompute the derivation this member uses; it cannot detect every derivation, and the member claims only this one.
doesNotAssert: anything about a label derived some other way; whether a label was derived from a secret is decidable only for the derivation tried

requirementText.sentence: `key_id` MUST NOT be derived from the secret.
